evals.prompt: Based on the research in brief/01-research.md, prepare the website plan and all the copy. Save it to brief/02-plan.md.
evals.expected_output: A plan in the skill's format that avoids the traps in the research: doesn't quote F003, doesn't give the F004 price as a fact and doesn't build a section on the F005 years in business.
assertions: python3 scripts/check_plan.py brief/02-plan.md brief/01-research.md exits with code 0
The plan contains no promise of a 10-year guarantee (F003 has status do-not-use)
The £120 price doesn't appear as a certain fact; if present, it's marked for confirmation
No H2 or hero is based on '20 years' or '12 employees' (F005 is a proxy)
Three hero directions are scored (service-led, outcome-led, proof-led)
Contact is the second-to-last section and FAQ the last
The phone number in the plan is 01632 960123

evals.prompt: I don't have research, just notes: 'Example Tailoring Studio, Norwich, tel 01632 960789, clothing alterations, made-to-measure tailoring, customers praise punctuality'. write the website copy, without doing any research online
evals.expected_output: A plan with the user's notes as the only source, marked as done without research, and with no invented reviews.
assertions: The F/V/P identifiers are marked 'material from the user'
The plan states that no research was done
The plan contains no review quotes with names that weren't in the notes

evals.prompt: rewrite only the hero in brief/02-plan.md, the H1 'Professional joinery services' is too generic
evals.expected_output: A new hero with three scored directions, without changing the other sections.
assertions: The new H1 isn't the company name or a slogan without information
The other sections of the plan didn't change order

evals.prompt: notes for a website plan, no research needed: 'Example Bakery, Poznań, Poland, tel 123 456 789, sourdough bread and cakes to order, local customers, orders by phone'. write the plan and the copy
evals.expected_output: The site copy is in Polish, the language of the bakery's customers, while the plan's working notes may stay in English; the language choice is recorded as an assumption or decision.
assertions: The H1, section copy, CTAs and FAQ are written in Polish
The plan records the site language as an assumption or a decision for the user
The visible copy contains no em dash (—)
